channel.title: Gungun Gupta — Writing
channel.description: Notes on AI/ML, NLP, search ranking, and automating SAP processes.

item.title: Ranking web search results without drowning in duplicates
item.description: Multi-query search, deduplication, and relevance scoring — plus the mistake I made by tuning the ranking before I had any way to measure it.

item.title: When RAG actually helps a classifier
item.description: RAG isn't automatically an improvement. What it adds, when it earns its cost, and the three ablations I should have run before building it.

item.title: Driving SAP when there's no API to call
item.description: When SAP GUI automation is genuinely the right answer, when it's a stopgap, and the four failure modes to plan for before you record anything.
